dedupe_keys.name: aspete greek 100 node medium voltage distribution network

description: ASPETE publishes a MATPOWER model of a real Greek medium-voltage distribution feeder to support steady-state smart-grid studies. The 100-node representation describes a 55-kilometre rural 20-kilovolt line with forty-five medium-to-low-voltage transformers and twenty-four photovoltaic connections. Installed load capacity is 12 MVA. The provided operating case uses maximum observed demand and half renewable production; supporting line data and results accompany the MATLAB case file. Harvard Dataverse releases the M and tab-separated files under CC0 1.0 with free access. Its named dataset API worked, while the HTML page returned an empty HTTP 202 response. Coverage is limited to one feeder operating snapshot, not an annual load series or a dynamic protection model. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing load aggregation, storage or demand-response scenarios. model-matpower is the documented execution environment, and model-pandapower is a related power-flow tool requiring conversion. No model file was downloaded or run.
